home: Login Home About Us Academics Life@SGDC Student Support Notices Committees Library Admissions Alumni IQAC NAAC Careers Placements Prospectus WOWSlider.com Gallery App by WOWSlider.com v4.9 Recruiters Programmes JUNIOR COLLEGE The Junior College offers courses in Science & Commerce streams prescribed by the Maharashtra State Board of Secondary & Higher Secondary Education at the 10+2 level. The courses lead to the Higher Secondary Certificate Examinations. Duration 2 years Awarding Authority Maharashtra State Board of Secondary & Higher Secondary Education, Pune. Subjects offered at Std. XI & XII Compulsory Language English 2nd Language (any one) Hindi Marathi Information Technology Scheme of Evaluation Students of F.Y.J.C. (Commerce & Science) have to appear for 4 exams in an academic year. Every student is expected to secure a minimum of 35 % marks in every subject to pass the academic year. The final result of the std. XI exams is based on the average marks secured in all the 4 exams. First Term First Unit Test 25 Marks Test (multiple choice questions) First Terminal Exam 50 Marks theory exam for all subjects Second Term Second Unit Test 25 Marks Test (multiple choice questions) Second Terminal Exam 100 Marks Exam 80 Marks theory exam and 20 marks orals (for languages). 80 Marks theory exam and 20 marks practical for mathematics and statistics. 80 Marks theory exam and 20 marks practical for information technology. 80 Marks theory exam and 20 marks project (for all commerce subjects). 20% of the questions in the second terminal exam will be based on the first term syllabus. Physical Education 50 Marks exam in each term 25 Marks written exam will be conducted during the first and second unit test. 25 Marks practical in each term. The average marks obtained by the student will be converted into grades and displayed on the final mark-sheet issued to the student for the academic year. Environmental Education Project and Essay submission in each term. (Total 50 marks for each term) 30 Marks project and 20 marks essay/journal has to be submitted in each term by every student. The average marks obtained by the student will be added to the total marks scored by the student in the academic year. Admission & Eligibility Admission to First year in Junior college (FYJC – Std XI) is offered following the declaration of result of S.S.C. examination by the Maharashtra State Board of Secondary & Higher Secondary Education. The admissions are given strictly as per the directions issued by the Department of Education, Govt. of Maharashtra from time to time. Since, the college has a Hindi Linguistic Minority status, the Hindi linguistic student will be given admission prior to the Online admission process. The candidates who have passed the S.S.C. examination of Maharashtra Board of Secondary & Higher Secondary Education or an examination regarded as equivalent by the State Board are eligible for admission to F.Y.J.C. (Std XI) class. The students who have passed the equivalent examination as mentioned above will have to produce a provisional eligibility certificate issued by the Divisional Secretary, Maharashtra State Board of Secondary Education, Sector no. 16, Vashi, Navi Mumbai- 400073. The eligible candidates have to apply in the prescribed form made available after the declaration of S.S.C. result. The schedule of admission as prescribed by the Deputy Director (Education), Dept. of education, Govt. of Maharashtra will be strictly followed. Students passing Std. X from CBSE and ICSE Boards will be considered at par with those who have passed the S.S.C. examination of the State Board. Documents to be submitted along with Admission Form 1. Statement of Marks 2 attested copies (Original to be shown at the time of admission). 2. School Leaving Certificate 1 attested copy (Original to be shown at the time of admission). 3. Caste Certificate (If applicable) – 1 attested copy (Original to be shown at the time of admission). Degree College has been a great contributor towards the development of my personality. By participating in the inter-college and intracollege events conducted by the College Management, I have established my leadership, time management and team skills and have also been able to advance these skills to whole new augment level. The professors provide us with real-world examples of how the concepts we are learning in class have being applied in. Presently I’m Working as Desktop Support Engineer in IndusInd Bank and also worked as System Engineer in Bajaj Allianz Kiran Patil B.B.I. Shri G.P.M. Degree College educates students in a very creative way and encourages us to think out of the box. However, the college not only helps me to excel in the academic field but also teaches me a lot about different cultures and how to appreciate them. Our College gives a great opportunity for us to broaden our knowledge beyond our field. Gonsalves Smith Nazareth B.Sci IT I would describe the Shri G.P.M. Degree College as exciting and dynamic place for UG level education. The best thing about being a student here is the number of additional opportunities that are available. I was initially attracted here by the school’s reputation and my career goals. The professors here make the college what it is today. With an attitude of being ever ready not only delivering classroom teachings but also providing the students with real-time case studies and hands on industry experience with field project works because of that activity presently, I am a youngest CyberSecurity Evangelist. To any new student coming to the College, I would say this : Throw yourself at every opportunity that comes your way. If it gets too much, you can always scale back but those opportunities can make all the difference between getting what you want and having to settle for second best. Mohammad Shahbaz B.A.F. I am pursuing B.A.F. from Shri G.P.M. Degree College of Science & Commerce and would like to add that the College and the faculty members are very student friendly and approachable in nature. The faculty members make sure that all the sessions are interactive and interesting in nature. They use a lot of case studies, discussions, role-plays and many innovative ways of evaluation. The College organizes various industrial visits, guest lectures, conferences and case conclaves to give a hands on experience to its students. It gives me great pleasure to say with pride that I have completed my B.A.F. from here. Rusell Coutinho B.Sci IT My journey at Shri G.P.M. Degree College for the past 3 years has been absolute amazing. The college faculties and administration have supported me and my endeavors throughout. The college regularly organizes workshops such as blood donation campaigns, beach cleaning drives and sports competitions to help students develop new skills. I have taken part in donating blood for 3 consecutive years at the blood drive organized by the college committees. Such achievements and experiences really helped me stand out amongst others and aided me to secure a job at the Mumbai International Airport as a customer service executive. The support I received from the college allowed me to explore various fields and then choose the one I liked. Aman Mishra B.Sci CS My experience at Shri G.P.M. Degree College of Science & Commerce was fantastic, and laid the foundation for a challenging journey in my life. It triggered my learning curve to rise towards knowledge and creativity. I was often encouraged to look beyond books. What I absorbed and assimilated from various orientation programmes and motivational programmes inculcated self-discipline and problem solving skills. Personally, the education and experience that I gained hear transformed me into a person eager taking on challenges in the real world. Amit Singh B.M.M. At the very outset, I would like to express my heartfelt thanks to Shri G.P.M. family. I extend my warm regards to my department which immensely helped me to succeed in my life. The friendly environment and the systematic approach in imparting education made me a competent individual. I can positively say that Shri G.P.M. Degree College has been the best part of my life and the most I admire is the support that I received from the management. I am thankful to you ever, Shri G.P.M. Degree College! Naved Shaikh B.M.S. It was a great experience studying at Shri G.P.M. Degree College of Science & Commerce. My experience here was full of learning and grooming myself in every aspect of my professional carrier. I feel fortunate to be a student of this college. We are blessed with very senior and experienced faculty. Since from last one and half year due to Covid-19 pandemics we all are attending online lectures & during that time our college has taken the initiative for giving us daily assignment so that study and concept could be easily remembered which helps me personally to score good in my TY examinations. Shilpa Bhanushali B.Com. My Life at Shri G.P.M. Degree College made me stronger and took me a step ahead for being independent women. I am thankful to all the teachers who supported us and corrected us throughout our bachelors. The events that I took part helped me to grow my confidence level. They care about how the student is doing within the course and whether we understand, rather than just giving out information and letting the students absorb it however they want.
